Rationale.Observation: The owner on 2026-10-08, the legal point: the charter's legal aspect (Board approvals, decisions, officials) is wrong because no decision creating an official center of competence as a department exists. The owner wants the registry clean (no names, no decisions, all Draft or Proposed, no dates set, the owner's mailbox kept for portal help, the portal live), v1 kept as a frozen package of site and charter and related files, and v2 from scratch with no reference to v1.

The owner on the model: the Hub is a shell that holds the full process and visualises instances of it. "anybody can bring and register projects and lead them through, they will be visualized via updated card - users just need to maintain updated card. if they keep it updated then site will show them correct in live view." The levels the Hub covers are the Funnel, the Portfolio and the Program; "the rest is in jira". It must not say on the site that it is a consolidation hub or that it has no authority: "do not say it or make a statement of it on the site. this is subtle assumption."

The owner on roles and decisions: only the functional roles business owner, product manager and project manager; no leads, no facilitator, no banking functions or their structure; decisions are taken on the spot or in the forums at each level (the product management forum, the program decision forum); the engagement model is generic and informal. The Hub keeps its intent as a community hub but is not a governance body.

The owner on content: keep the intent, wording, shape and form of v1's inspirational text, with no documents, no formal numbering, clause references or document codes; softer, agile-friendly, like SAFe; each page has a page id beside the URL, shown without a copy button; work items keep their ids; the Hub is only the wrapping and shell.

The owner on language and names: Russian is written natively as the source of truth and English is translated later; each industry keyword shows its English term, for example воронка (funnel); the vocabulary is Russian with the English term and an explanation. Title AI Competence Hub, Competence Hub as the middle form for navigation and general reference, Hub as the short form, AICC kept as a label or code.

The owner on packaging: one deployable package; the documents are deployed with the site under each version's root (assets, charter, registry, portfolio, program and so on); nothing leads outside; when deployed to a real server the live data will move to a runtime share. The registry of v2 is the catalog holding the portfolio with its projects and cards.

The owner on work: the initiatives stay as they are because they are actual projects; new run-rate work automates routine processing of report preparation and forms for the HR and Compliance functions with Claude automation on the workspace of each employee.
Rationale.Recommendation: Carried design from the superseded draft: four levels, of which the Hub covers three (Funnel, Portfolio, Program) and links the fourth (Team in Jira); Portfolio states Funnel, Shaping, Ready, Doing, Done; decisions Start, Invest and Persevere/pivot/stop, taken by the business owner and the forum, never by a lead; pull as a limit on work in progress; classes of service run-rate, initiative and urgent; WSJF only as a tie-breaker; decisions by a pre-agreed rule and a named decider, with the forum looking at flow and exceptions; exit criterion, appetite and stop threshold fixed before work starts; the log of decisions kept on the card.

Governance floor reframed: the Hub has none of its own. Each profile carries a short good-practice checklist for the kind of work (what is usually checked, with whom, with what evidence), shown as practice and not as a control; the people running the work answer to their own Bank rules. The HR and Compliance cards show the check about employee workspaces visibly.

Project Profile: static theory on the site, in the Program part: how a kind of work is run (stages, roles, decisions and forums, checklist, card template). First four kinds: initiative delivery, run-rate work, a recurring control-like activity, and an enablement programme. Project Card (карточка проекта): the live instance, one structured file (YAML checked by a schema) per project in the portfolio folder, owned by the project manager. Minimum fields: identity (id, title, kind, profile, stage); people (business owner, product manager, project manager as positions and holders); outcome (problem, intended outcome, measure with baseline, target); constraints (appetite, review point); checklist state; live state (status, next step, top risks, dependencies, flow data); work (Capabilities and Features as rows with Jira keys); log of decisions (what, who, when); closure (result, lessons); links to Jira and Confluence.

Folder shape: aicc/v1 and aicc/v2 are self-contained packages under one top folder; each builds into html/aicc/v1 or html/aicc/v2 and publishes its own source files under its root; html/aicc holds the chooser. Inside v2 the sources are Russian first (ru/ is the source, en/ the later translation), with the portfolio folder holding the catalog: discovery, profiles, initiatives and their cards; views by area, category, function and state are generated at build time.

v1 cleaning scope (to be reviewed by the owner after the rebuild): appointments, holders and names removed; Decision Records, the Decision Log entries, the Steering note and the supplements removed; statuses Approved, Accepted, Decided, Met, Appointed and Closed reset to Draft, Proposed, Open or Not started; Standing Initiatives and ordinary initiatives shown as Proposed in the Funnel; decision dates blanked; the charter's change-log references to Decision Records replaced by a dash; a Draft status chip on every page; the owner's mailbox kept.

Execution order: T-001 record; T-002 clean v1 in place while its tooling is intact; T-003 relocate it as the self-contained v1 package and add the chooser; T-004 fork the shell and tooling into v2 and flip the source language to Russian; T-005 v2 content; T-006 cards and the views; T-007 verify and publish.

Alternatives.Alternative: Freezing v1 unchanged: rejected, because it would keep presenting named decisions and officials; the owner chose the cleaned rebuild.
One tree with versions as branches: rejected in favour of two self-contained packages, so that each is deployable and maintainable on its own.
A Hub with a lead, appointments or its own Decision Records: rejected; the roles are functional and live on the card.
A site statement describing the Hub as a consolidation hub without authority: rejected by the owner; the site presents the process and the instances.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: Russian names of the Hub: «Хаб Компетенций по AI», «Хаб Компетенций», «Хаб» are used unless the owner changes them.
Whether the English translation of v2 is scheduled; until then an English page shows the Russian text.
The live runtime share for cards with names and positions, when the site moves to a real server.
What the community idea shows when it is brought forward.
The check on employee workspaces for the HR and Compliance automation, which the people running the work take to their own Bank functions.

Scenarios.Scenario: A project manager opens the card of her project, updates the stage and the next step, and the Portfolio and Program views show the change at the next render.

An employee of a function registers an idea as a card in the Funnel; the business owner and the product manager take it through the states; the product management forum looks at what is blocked or aging.
A reader opens the page of the run-rate profile, sees the process, the roles and the checklist, then follows the link to the card of the HR routine automation.
The owner opens /aicc/ and chooses between the archived v1 and the Hub v2.
